records.summary: After her husband Grigory's apparent death, Lyudmila (Ekaterina Astakhova) loses her memory of a stretch of time and finds out about 1.5 months later that she is pregnant. A hypnosis session is used to recover the missing memories. She learns Grigory lived under a false name, faked his death and is the father; she later gives birth to a daughter and accepts a proposal from Vladimir.

episodes.gist: Lyudmila's husband Grigory is reported dead after a fishing trip; after the funeral she walks to the lake and wakes up in hospital with no memory of the interval; a psychotherapist appears in this part
About 1.5 months later a gynaecologist tells her she is pregnant although she had no intimacy for over 3 months; she sees a psychotherapist, meets Tamara, and traces Vladimir via camera footage
She learns Grigory used another name, left debts and faked his death, and that he is the father of the baby; Vladimir helps her when she is attacked
Lyudmila is accused of Grigory's death, Vladimir's son is kidnapped and rescued; 7 months later she gives birth to a girl and accepts Vladimir's proposal
